component.name: Boot Story
component.summary: See how Linux and Plasma assembled the current boot

description.p: Boot Story turns systemd boot timing into a proportional timeline, the actual graphical critical path, and a clearly separated list of long parallel activations.
Select a visible unit to learn why it ran, what it depends on, and the local systemd evidence behind the explanation without starting from a wall of services.
It learns a private local median across boots without a resident service or network access.
